comment: LynB7 functions as a termination-stage oxidative decarboxylase that synthesizes the C-terminal thiazole ring of lyngbyapeptin B

reactions.description: LynB7 catalyzes the oxidative decarboxylation of 2-thiazoline-4-carboxylic acid to fully conjugated 2-thiazole moiety in the lyngbyapeptin B biosynthesis
